scope: The second part of the laws-compared admission (2026-11-05), under the maintainer's decisions of 2026-11-03, 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05, adds schema 2.31 and one record for each answered cell of the collection "Laws compared": ten binding instruments, the EU Code of Practice as a compliance route and two texts revoked or with a rescission announced, put the same fifteen questions; it adds the Illinois AI Safety Measures Act's enacted text, read in a saved copy, and its legislature. A cell records what a text requires, not whether any developer is covered or complied. All records are seeds.

illinois.name: Illinois Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act (Public Act 104-0538)
illinois.description: Illinois Public Act 104-0538 (SB 315, 104th General Assembly), the Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act: duties on developers of frontier AI models, including a published safety framework, transparency reports, incident reporting and whistleblower protection. Read in a saved copy of the enacted text; the Governor approved it on 6 July 2026, according to the checker's copy of the bill status record.

documentVersion.label: Public Act 104-0538, as enacted (approved 6 July 2026)
documentVersion.dateNote: Approval by the Governor on 6 July 2026, recorded as the date of issue, according to the official bill status record as the cross-family checker read it in an Internet Archive capture of 2026-07-31; the preparer could not open the record. Section 99 states that the act takes effect on 1 January 2027; some duties apply from 1 January 2028 (Section 10).
